messages.subject: Quick-TRANSfer warning
parts:
Hi all,
Does anyone tell me what "Quick-TRANSfer stage steps exceeded maximum (= 2677600)" warning means while performing spatialShrunkenCentroids analysis for example. 
How does this warning affect the result of the analysis?
Thank you
Paco

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Quick-TRANSfer warning
parts:
That's a warning from the FORTRAN code in R's built-in kmeans function, which is used to initialize the segmentation. I've never noticed it to have an effect on the final results.

-Kylie

messages.author: 0ffbf67e87ab2b30
messages.subject: Re: Quick-TRANSfer warning
parts: Make sure you check your clusters$ifault value. If it is 0 to the best of my knowledge this warning hasn't affect your clustering ( please correct me if i am wrong)
